newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Harvey Norman year sales up 16.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Harvey Norman year sales up 16.7 pct.

text.p: Furniture and electrical goods retailer Harvey Norman Holdings Ltd said its sales for the year to June 30, 1997 rose 16.7 percent to A$1.216 billion, while like store sales rose 12.2 percent for the year.
Harvey Norman said the sales figures included sales from the franchised Harvey Norman stores and from the group's own store at Lismore, in New South Wales.
It said it had opened its first New Zealand store at Wairau Park near Auckland on July 1 and would open a second store in Manukau in Auckland on September 1.
Total sales for the first half of the year rose 13.7 percent to A$601.86 million, but Harvey Norman said in March the retail market continued to be difficult.
Harvey Norman Managing Director Michael Harvey said in January that the group was then trailing its target for 15 percent annual sales growth.
Harvey was not immediately available for comment on the latest sales results.

Harvey Norman posted a net profit of A$18.14 million in the first half of the 1996/97 year, up from A$16.73 million in the same half a year earlier, while its full 1995/96 year profit fell 6.7 percent to A$30.41 million.
Harvey Norman's shares were untraded by 11.15 a.m. (0115 GMT), having closed unchanged at A$7.64 on Thursday.
